## Overview

- Open external links from Desktop slide content in the user's default browser.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.5 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. Update version-pinned installation links to `v4.2.5`.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.5`. |
| External slide links | No action is required; Desktop now opens supported external links in the default browser. |
